Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the questionnaire. A few quick answers and requests from our side: 

- SOC 2: For production integrations that will handle PHI, we require a SOC 2 Type II attestation. For pilots, our procurement can accept a Type I with a strong roadmap to Type II, but the preference is Type II. Do you have an expected timeline for Type II?
- HIPAA: Our legal team will need confirmation on BAAs/encryption-at-rest keys and whether Redwood will sign a BAA.
- Questionnaire: We've received the attachment. Our security team (cc'd) will start filling it out. Estimated turnaround is ~7 business days, but we'll let you know if anything is missing.

Also looping in our security lead (security@medicahealth.com) — they may request example controls or evidence.

Thanks — useful thread. A few clarifying notes and a proposed compliance roadmap so everyone has visibility: 

- Current SOC status: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type I (security) as of 2025 and we are targeting SOC 2 Type II completion by Q4 2026. I've attached a short readiness summary that highlights audit scope, control maturity, and estimated timeline.
- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA. We support customer-managed keys in Private deployments and have documented encryption-at-rest and in-transit controls; Ethan can share the technical spec in the follow-up call.
- Roadmap & certifications: 
  • Q3 2026: Expand SOC 2 scope to include availability & confidentiality controls for Private deployments (targeted scope expansion).
  • Q4 2026: Complete SOC 2 Type II audit.
  • 2027 (planning): Evaluate ISO 27001 certification and a FedRAMP readiness assessment for customers in government health programs — these will be scoped based on demand.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I'll send the completed vendor questionnaire answers to your security team by next Wednesday (2026-06-17).
2) Schedule 30-min technical call with Ethan to review BAA, KMS options, and audit evidence (please share availability).
3) Rishi — if you can draft a short MAP tying Type II delivery to production acceptance, that will help procurement.

Attachments: SOC2_readiness_summary.pdf

If that timeline works, I'll flag the MAP milestone dates when Rishi shares the draft.
